source_work.title: A Novel Unified Framework for Automated Generation and Multimodal Validation of UML Diagrams

source_inventory.nl_count_basis: assets/extracted/pairs.jsonl and raw HF parquet input column
source_inventory.duplicate_nl_note: Exact and whitespace-normalized checks found 989 unique NL among 989 eligible rows; no 1xN NL-to-multiple-STM pattern was found.
source_inventory.construction_note: Synthetic user-focused feature descriptions generated by LLaMA-3.2-1B-Instruct; PlantUML generated by DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B and regex-extracted as @startuml...@enduml blocks.
source_inventory.quality_note: Paper reports pipeline-level rendering/VLM/expert validation, but the HF state parquet does not include per-row VLM/human scores; local eligibility is simple PlantUML block structure.
source_inventory.quality_sample_note: Local sample of rows 0--4 covers restaurant ordering/menu, auto-tagging, product recommendation, content management and task management; these are generic software feature descriptions, not control-system requirements.

source_inventory.notes: 989 个 eligible PlantUML pair；NL 是 synthetic feature descriptions，不是控制系统真实需求。

data_construction.paper_claim_summary: 论文描述先由 LLaMA-3.2-1B-Instruct 生成 end-user feature descriptions，再由 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 生成 PlantUML，并用正则抽取 @startuml...@enduml；完整数据集为 synthetic UML dataset，本条目使用 Hugging Face UMLCode_StateDiagram state-diagram train split。
data_construction.generation_or_construction_pipeline: synthetic feature description -> LLM PlantUML generation -> regex extraction -> dataset row (input, reasoning, uml_code)。
data_construction.what_is_raw_nl: parquet input 列：合成的通用软件 feature description / requirement-like text。
data_construction.what_is_stm0: parquet uml_code 列：DeepSeek 生成并抽取出的 PlantUML state diagram；No valid PlantUML code found 行不计入 STM_0。

quality_audit.quality_findings: 5 个有效样本均含 @startuml/@enduml 与状态迁移，3 个失败样本为 No valid PlantUML code found 并已排除；未发现重复 NL 或 1×N 映射。
quality_audit.domain_fit_caveat: 通用软件 synthetic feature，不是控制系统真实需求；适合 synthetic UML smoke/stress，不应包装为真实控制系统 seed。
